propositions: close_ticket appends the completion signature AFTER releasing the lock, so a transient lock timeout during sign append occurs ~60s after close lands, raising SigningError with exit 0 and no programmatic failure marker
completion_signature outcome is not reported in the close_ticket return payload, so callers cannot distinguish a successful close from one whose signature was silently dropped
the failure message presents a lock error as a close failure when the close succeeded; callers cannot determine whether to retry

completion_signature {signed, cause, error} is now returned on every close where a signature was in play, with cause in {signed, sign_failed, material_drifted, force_bypassed}, absent for plain transitions and idea->closed
the new field is threaded through the public API surfaces: rebar.transition() library call, CLI --output json, and MCP transition_ticket, and survives via schema and TypedDict
the error message now leads with the close having landed and only the signature having failed, explicitly advising against retry
